purpose: Teach: 小切手/インターンシップ/本案/公言/借り入れ/呼び名/生年月日/ベーシック

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、小切手詐欺の事件を捜査されますね
lines.en: The police investigate check-fraud cases, don't they?
lines.style: Measured, respectful tone. Steady pace. Acknowledging competence without flattery. A gentle statement of fact, not a question seeking reassurance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、インターンシップ警察学生を受け入れられますね
lines.en: The police accept interns from the academy, don't they?
lines.style: Same respectful cadence. Slightly warmer — noting something positive. Even pacing, no hesitation. Still observational, not probing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本案には市民の協力が不可欠ですね
lines.en: Citizen cooperation is essential for this initiative, isn't it?
lines.style: Conversational but deliberate. Slight emphasis on 'essential.' Warm recognition of collaborative effort. Pace steady, engaged but not urgent.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不祥事を起こした警察官の処分を公言されますね
lines.en: The police publicly hold officers accountable when misconduct occurs, don't they?
lines.style: Firmer now. Light conviction in the delivery — this matters. Not accusatory, but clear-eyed. Direct eye contact level maintained.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不正借り入れの捜査もご対応ですね
lines.en: The police also investigate illegal loans, don't they?
lines.style: Returning to measured tone. Factual, thorough. Acknowledging the breadth of their work without over-praising. Even, professional cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の呼び名を変えるご配慮もされてますね
lines.en: You're thoughtful about how you refer to suspects, aren't you?
lines.style: Quieter now, more personal. Noticing something specific and respectful. Slower pace. Genuine appreciation without being effusive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の生年月日確認を厳格にされますね
lines.en: You verify suspect identification very carefully, don't you?
lines.style: Serious tone. Small weight on 'carefully.' Recognition of due diligence. Steady, no rushing. Professional respect for thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民にもベーシックな防犯知識を伝えられますね
lines.en: And you make sure citizens understand basic crime prevention too, don't you?
lines.style: Warmer, slightly closer. 'And' draws a human connection — going beyond the job. Softer pace. Genuine recognition of community care.
